# Run `pnpm interfaces` after changing them. Format: ITEM | ATTRIBUTES | DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat | channel | WeChat messaging through the standalone native daemon.
channel agent-wechat.allowFrom | array | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.backend | string, values native | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls | object | Independent voice and video permissions. Voice includes direct calls and separately configured conferences; both default off.
channel agent-wechat.calls.video | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.video.enabled | boolean, default false | Allow video independently of voice. Current video capability is unavailable; permission alone never answers a video call or routes it as voice.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.agentId | string, min length 1, max length 200 | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.allowConsultSessionPersistence | boolean, default false | Required for consultation. OpenClaw creates separate agent sessions for calls which can persist. This adapter stores no recordings; with consultation.summary it keeps the last few call summaries for each contact.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.conferences | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.conferences.groups | object | Exact group IDs or '*'. An exact rule overrides the wildcard, including autoJoin=false. Wildcard auto-join requires autoJoinAllowFrom; use ['*'] to accept any inviter.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.conferences.groups.* | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.conferences.groups.*.autoJoin | boolean, default false | Join current authenticated invitations matching this group rule after voice preflight. No configured groups means no conference automation.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.conferences.groups.*.autoJoinAllowFrom | array, max items 128 | Conference inviter IDs; '*' accepts any inviter and an empty list disables auto-join. Required for wildcard-group auto-join. An exact group may omit this field to accept any inviter. The current inviter is rechecked before joining.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.conferences.groups.*.ownerInviterToolPolicy | string, values none|safe-read-only|owner | Optional policy for calls whose authenticated inviter exactly matches an agent-wechat:CONTACT_ID owner grant. Otherwise toolPolicy applies. Owner also requires voice.toolPolicy=owner and an exact group owner grant. Applies to the whole call, including later participants; permissions can decrease but cannot increase during a call.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.conferences.groups.*.sessionKey | string, max length 1024, pattern ^agent:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}:[^:\s][^\s]*$ | Optional consultation parent session of this voice agent for this group. Default sessions are isolated by account, group and authority.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.conferences.groups.*.toolPolicy | string, values none|safe-read-only|owner, default safe-read-only | Conference consultation authority. Owner requires voice.toolPolicy=owner and an exact agent-wechat:GROUP_ID grant in commands.ownerAllowFrom. It trusts the whole group without attributing speech to a person; otherwise consultation stays read-only.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.consultation | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.consultation.inboundSessionKey | string, max length 1024, pattern ^agent:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}:[^:\s][^\s]*$ | Optional existing session of the selected agent to fork into a call's session when that session is first created by an admitted incoming call.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.consultation.recentMessages | integer, min 0, max 50, default 10 | How many of the latest messages of your WeChat chat with the caller the call's first consultation gets as context; 0 turns this off.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.consultation.summary | boolean, default true | After an answered call, give the call's transcript to the agent in the call's session and keep its short summary. The summary is also left as a note in your WeChat chat with the caller, and calls placed with the wechat_call tool report it to the session that placed them.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.consultation.timeoutMs | integer, min 1000, max 120000, default 30000 | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.enabled | boolean, default false | Enable voice calling. Conferences require an exact group rule or an explicit wildcard group rule. Disabled voice calls are ignored without answering or declining.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.inboundAllowFrom | array, max items 128 | Direct-call caller IDs; an explicit '*' accepts any incoming caller. Admission does not grant owner consultation.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.inboundPolicy | string, values disabled|allowlist | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.maxDurationSeconds | integer, min 30, max 3600, default 3600 | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.mode | string, values bidi|agent, default bidi | bidi uses a realtime voice model (including Live); agent transcribes speech, runs the configured OpenClaw agent and speaks through OpenClaw TTS. Applies to direct calls and conferences.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.outboundAllowTo | array, max items 128 | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.outboundPolicy | string, values disabled|allowlist | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.outboundToolAllowFrom | array, max items 128 | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.agentContext | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.agentContext.enabled | boolean, default false | Use OpenClaw's shared voice context to send bounded IDENTITY.md, USER.md and SOUL.md excerpts for direct calls and conferences. Configured agent identity is used independently; normal agent/TTS turns already receive host context.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.consultFastMode | boolean | Set fast mode for the regular OpenClaw consultation run when its model supports it.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.consultPolicy | string, values auto|substantive|always, default auto | Guide when the voice model consults. Always can use a final caller utterance as the consultation question when the voice model does not consult. GPT-Live models do not support always.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.consultThinkingLevel | string, values off|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|adaptive|max|ultra | Thinking level for the regular OpenClaw consultation run.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.instructions | string, max length 4000 | Additional conversation guidance; does not grant tool or account-owner authority.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.model | string, min length 1, max length 200 | Speech model, such as gpt-realtime-2.1 or the continuous gpt-live-1-codex; omitted uses the selected provider's default.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.provider | string, min length 1, max length 200 | Use openai. Other providers fail preflight without fallback.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.providers | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.providers.openai | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.providers.openai.apiKey | - | Optional OpenClaw SecretRef or API-key string. Omitted uses the selected agent's OpenAI auth profile or Gateway environment.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.recentContext | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.recentContext.enabled | boolean, default false | When a call starts, send the Realtime provider the summaries of the last few calls with this contact and the latest messages of your WeChat chat with them, so the voice model knows what you last talked about.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.recentContext.maxMessages | integer, min 1, max 50, default 10 | How many of the latest chat messages to include.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.realtime.voice | string, min length 1, max length 200 | Spoken voice; omitted uses the selected provider's default.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.sessionScope | string, values per-contact|per-call, default per-contact | per-contact keeps one session for each contact, so the agent remembers earlier calls with them; per-call starts every call in a new session.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.toolPolicy | string, values none|safe-read-only|owner | Owner uses the normal agent tool policy only for an exact agent-wechat entry in commands.ownerAllowFrom matching the connected voice peer. Other admitted peers get read-only consultation. Defaults to safe-read-only with session persistence, otherwise none.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.transcription | object | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.transcription.apiKey | - | Optional OpenClaw SecretRef or API-key string for the transcription provider. Omitted uses provider configuration.
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.transcription.language | string, min length 1, max length 200 | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.transcription.model | string, min length 1, max length 200 | MISSING DESCRIPTION
channel agent-wechat.calls.voice.transcription.provider | string, min length 1, max length 200, default openai | Registered realtime transcription provider for agent mode.
